21K likes, 41 comments - eattripclick on October 8, 2026: "Road trip with the right EV is an amazing experience without constantly thinking about charging.

I took the Maruti Suzuki e VITARA from Hyderabad to my favourite Irani chai spot 200 km away. Plenty of range, a comfortable cabin, home charging sorted with the complimentary charger and installation, and Battery-as-a-Service making the switch to electric feel a little less intimidating.

If you’ve been waiting to switch to EV,  it’s time to take the Maruti Suzuki e VITARA out for a spin.

#eVITARA #MarutiSuzuki
